title: Should We Skip Diffusion?
title_zh: DDT-RFE: 一种改进的解耦扩散变换器模型

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models learn semantic representations while generating images. In the Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT), a condition encoder provides features that guide a velocity decoder in denoising. To enable effective denoising at all noise levels, these features must capture both high-level abstract structures and low-level details. However, skip/residual connections in the encoder allow shallow features to bypass successive transformations, which may limit progressive abstraction, or at least make it difficult to disentangle different levels of abstraction. We propose DDT-RFE, which removes the residual connections around the Self-Attention and MLP operations in each encoder block while maintaining stable training. To retain the information that abstraction discards but that the decoder still needs, we fuse the input patch embedding with intermediate and final encoder features to form the encoder output. The decoder thus has access to information from multiple encoder depths, while each encoder block is able to learn more abstract representations. DDT-RFE achieves overall improvements over DDT across visual understanding tasks, including image classification, semantic segmentation, object discovery, and semantic correspondence, while using fewer encoder blocks. It also achieves a lower FID for image generation on ImageNet.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion transformers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) have emerged as a dominant backbone for image generation, achieving remarkable fidelity and diversity across a wide range of visual domains. Beyond synthesis, their intermediate activations encode semantic information that supports downstream visual recognition and dense prediction tasks ( Stracke et al., 2025 ; Gan et al., 2025 ; Helbling et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2023 ) . Crucially, representation learning and image synthesis are not independent processes: in standard diffusion transformers, semantic abstraction and fine-grained signal reconstruction are implicitly coupled within the same denoising network. Recent work has begun to explicitly decouple these two roles ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT) ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , for example, introduces a “condition encoder” for learning representations and a “velocity decoder” for signal reconstruction. The condition encoder retains the standard diffusion transformer block design and transforms noisy inputs into representations that provide the decoder with information useful for reconstruction, including abstract structures and low-level image details.

paragraphs.en: However, how the encoder develops abstract features and combines features at different levels affect the quality of the representations that are provided to the decoder. In DDT, each encoder block transforms its input and integrates the resulting features with the input through residual connections ( He et al., 2016 ) . Stacking blocks allows features to undergo successive transformations, which supports abstract representations. At the same time, residual connections carry information from earlier blocks into the inputs of later transformations. Although this can retain information useful for reconstruction, we hypothesize that the repeated accumulation of shallow features may hinder abstraction from the noisy input ( Ji et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . As shown in Fig. 1 , object structure remains difficult to distinguish in the visualized DDT encoder features, even in deeper blocks. This raises a central question: can the encoder develop more abstract features through successive transformations, while combining them with earlier features at its output, to provide the decoder with information at multiple levels of abstraction?
paragraphs.zh: 然而，编码器如何形成抽象特征以及如何在不同层级上整合这些特征，会影响提供给解码器的表示质量。 在 DDT 中，每个编码器块都会对其输入进行转换，并通过残差连接将所得特征与输入相整合（He et al., 2016）。 堆叠多个编码器块可使特征经历连续转换，从而支持抽象表示的形成。 同时，残差连接会将早期块的信息传递到后续转换的输入中。 尽管这可以保留对重建有用的信息，但我们推测，浅层特征的重复累积可能会阻碍从噪声输入中提取抽象特征（Ji et al., 2026a；Zhang et al., 2026）。 如图 1 所示，即使在较深的编码器块中，可视化后的 DDT 编码器特征仍然难以区分物体结构。 这引出了一个核心问题：编码器能否通过连续转换形成更抽象的特征，同时在输出端将其与早期特征相结合，从而为解码器提供多个抽象层级的信息？

paragraphs.en: To address this, we propose DDT with a Residual-Free Encoder (DDT-RFE), which combines a residual-free condition encoder with explicit fusion of intermediate and final encoder features to condition the decoder. We remove the residual connections around the Self-Attention and MLP operations in each encoder block, eliminating the identity shortcuts through which earlier features bypass these transformations. This design encourages progressive abstraction through successive transformations. In order to improve the convergence of the residual-free encoder, we propose an initialization scheme inspired by Ji et al. (2026a) but with fewer hyperparameters to tune. To retain access to information that is lost during abstraction but may still be needed for reconstruction, we fuse the input patch embedding and intermediate encoder features with the final encoder block output to form the decoder’s condition. The decoder can therefore access representations at different levels, without requiring all useful information to persist in the final encoder block representation.

paragraphs.en: DiT ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) establishes a scalable backbone for latent diffusion built from a stack of transformer blocks. U-DiT ( Tian et al., 2024 ) adds long skip connections that carry shallow features to deeper layers. Other designs separate the learning of semantic representations from reconstruction. In pixel-space diffusion, PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2026 ) models global semantics at the patch level in an encoder and refines details at the pixel level in a decoder. DDT ( Wang et al., 2026 ) uses a condition encoder to learn representations that condition a velocity decoder for signal reconstruction. We build on the condition encoder of DDT so that the representations learned in the encoder can be studied in isolation from the decoder.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion denoising has been studied as a self-supervised objective for learning visual representations that transfer effectively to downstream tasks. Through pretraining on image generation, Xiang et al. (2023) demonstrate that diffusion models learn linearly separable intermediate representations and achieve image classification performance comparable to that of contemporary contrastive methods. For diffusion transformers, DiTF ( Gan et al., 2025 ) investigates the capabilities of DiTs for accurate dense correspondence and proposes a training-free method to extract semantically discriminative features from DiTs, achieving superior performance across multiple benchmarks. Furthermore, CleanDIFT ( Stracke et al., 2025 ) introduces a lightweight, unsupervised fine-tuning method that enables diffusion backbones to provide high-quality, noise-free semantic features for downstream visual tasks. Our work examines how the condition encoder shapes representations, with a focus on progressive abstraction, and how information that may be discarded during this process can remain accessible to the decoder for reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: Residual connections affect both optimization and the learned representations. Ji et al. (2025) link the training difficulties caused by removing attention shortcuts to poor network conditioning in self-attention and analyze how residual pathways improve network conditioning. To address this optimization challenge, subsequent work develops initialization and optimization strategies that enable effective training of residual-free transformers ( Ji et al., 2026a ; Ji et al., 2026b ) . Beyond optimization, residual pathways allow information from earlier blocks to persist in deeper representations ( Raghu et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Ji et al. (2026a) further report that residual-free vision transformers learn more abstract representations and achieve improved performance on dense prediction tasks. An additional consideration in our setting is how to include more abstract features in the representations provided to the decoder while retaining other information useful for reconstruction. Our work examines this question in DDT by removing residual connections within the condition encoder and aggregating features from different depths at its encoder output.
paragraphs.zh: 残差连接同时影响优化过程和所学到的表示。Ji 等人（2025）将移除注意力快捷方式所导致的训练困难，归因于自注意力机制中网络条件化效果不佳，并分析了残差路径如何改善网络条件化。为应对这一优化挑战，后续研究提出了初始化和优化策略，使得无需残差连接的 Transformer 能够被有效训练（Ji 等人，2026a；Ji 等人，2026b）。除了优化之外，残差路径还允许早期模块的信息在更深层的表示中得以保留（Raghu 等人，2021；Zhang 等人，2026）。Ji 等人（2026a）进一步指出，无需残差连接的视觉 Transformer 能够学习到更具抽象性的表示，并在密集预测任务上取得更好的性能。在我们设定的框架中，另一个需要考虑的问题是：如何在向解码器提供的表示中纳入更抽象的特征，同时保留对重建有用的其他信息。我们的研究通过在条件编码器中移除残差连接，并在其编码器输出端聚合不同深度的特征，在 DDT 中探讨了这一问题。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our methods in training diffusion transformers from scratch on the ImageNet-1k dataset at a resolution of 256 × 256 256\times 256 and patch size of 2 for 80 epochs, using a total training batch size of 1024. Following Zhou et al. (2026) , we use the Muon optimizer with a constant learning rate of 0.0002 and a momentum of 0.95 throughout training. We set the gradient clipping threshold to 1, weight decay to 0, and the exponential moving average (EMA) decay rate to 0.9999. We use the off-the-shelf VAE-ft-EMA from Hugging Face 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-ema , with a downsampling factor of 8. For sampling, we use the Euler solver with 250 steps. We train both DDT and DDT-RFE in both Large (L) and Extra Large (XL) configurations, with 458M and 675M parameters, respectively. For DDT-RFE, we set ρ = 0.1 \rho=0.1 for the L configuration and ρ = 0 \rho=0 for the XL configuration. The original DDT training setup ( Wang et al., 2026 ) incorporates REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) to align intermediate encoder features with representations from a pretrained visual encoder. We omit this auxiliary alignment objective in our experiments to examine the encoder representations learned through the generative objective. We evaluate both representation learning tasks using the intermediate features learned by the diffusion transformer models and the generation performance of our trained models.

paragraphs.en: Detecting salient objects is a fundamental problem in computer vision with applications in real-world vision systems. To address this problem, recent methods, such as LOST ( Siméoni et al., 2021 ) and TokenCuT ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , use self-supervised pretrained models to obtain high-quality, abstract feature representations without requiring manual labels. We evaluate unsupervised object discovery using LOST, which localizes the salient object in an image using token features from a frozen model. We apply LOST to representations extracted from each transformer block and report the best results. We evaluate on VOC2012 and COCO20k and report correct localization (CorLoc), defined as the fraction of images for which the predicted bounding box has an intersection-over-union (IoU) greater than 0.5 with a ground-truth bounding box.
paragraphs.zh: 检测显著对象是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题，在现实世界的视觉系统中有着广泛应用。 为了解决这个问题，近期的一些方法（如 LOST（Siméoni 等人，2021）和 TokenCuT（Wang 等人，2023））利用自监督预训练模型来获取高质量的抽象特征表示，而无需手动标注。 我们使用 LOST 对无监督对象发现进行了评估，该方法通过冻结模型中的标记特征来定位图像中的显著对象。 我们将 LOST 应用于从每个 Transformer 块中提取的表示，并报告了最佳结果。 我们在 VOC2012 和 COCO20k 数据集上进行了评估，并报告了正确定位率（CorLoc），其定义为预测边界框与真实边界框的交并比（IoU）大于 0.5 的图像比例。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports CorLoc results. At both model scales, DDT-RFE improves over DDT by about 16 % on VOC2012 and 10 % on COCO20k. LOST relies on a clear separation between foreground and background features. When features retain too much low-level information from shallow blocks, patch similarities may reflect local appearance more than object structure. This can make it harder to select a foreground seed and identify the full object. With the residual-free encoder, tokens from the same object have more similar features, as also shown in Fig. 1 . paragraphs.en: Semantic correspondence aims to match points on corresponding parts of different instances of the same object category. These instances may differ in appearance, pose, viewpoint, and scale. This task tests whether local features capture consistent semantic information across images and support accurate localization of object parts. We evaluate zero-shot semantic correspondence on SPair-71k ( Min et al., 2019 ) , which is the most challenging semantic correspondence dataset, containing diverse variations in viewpoint and scale with 12,234 image pairs on 18 categories for testing, following the protocol of DIFT ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . We report PCK@0.1 bbox {}_{\text{bbox}} , the percentage of keypoints whose predicted matches lie within 0.1 × max ⁡ ( w , h ) 0.1\times\max(w,h) of their ground-truth locations, where w w and h h are the width and height of the target object’s bounding box.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 reports mIoU on the three datasets. On VOC2012, DDT-RFE outperforms DDT by about 6 mIoU at both L and XL scales, with single-block and with multi-scale features. On ADE20K and COCO-Stuff, the single-block gains are smaller. At the XL scale, DDT-RFE matches DDT on COCO-Stuff and is 0.3 mIoU below it on ADE20K. We attribute this to the greater scene complexity of these datasets, where multi-scale information is critical. The residual connections of DDT mix representations implicitly across depth, so a single block already carries multi-level information. However, the residual-free encoder carries more abstract but less multi-scale features. Multi-scale probing is consistent with this and it benefits DDT-RFE more than DDT on both scene datasets (for example, +2.9 versus +1.8 mIoU on ADE20K at the L scale), and with multi-scale features DDT-RFE leads on every dataset at both scales. In the residual-free encoder, abstraction arises within the hierarchy and multi-scale context is recovered by aggregation. DDT-RFE achieves these results with a shallower encoder than DDT, obtaining better semantic representations at lower cost.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we studied how residual connections in the condition encoder shape the representations learned by diffusion transformers, with a focus on how the encoder learns abstract features. We introduced DDT-RFE, which combines a residual-free encoder with feature aggregation at its output. This design allows successive encoder blocks to transform features without identity shortcuts, while keeping information from different encoder depths accessible to the decoder. With the proposed initialization, DDT-RFE achieves overall improvements over DDT across four visual understanding tasks using fewer encoder blocks. It also achieves a lower FID for image generation on ImageNet under the same training budget. Our ablations further show the importance of both initialization and output feature aggregation. Together, these results suggest that separating feature transformation within the encoder from aggregation at its output can benefit both representation learning and image generation. We hope that our findings encourage the community to reconsider how information flows between blocks and how this affects the learning of abstract representations in diffusion models.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了条件编码器中的残差连接如何塑造扩散Transformer所学到的表示，重点关注编码器如何学习抽象特征。 我们提出了DDT-RFE，它将一个无残差的编码器和输出端的特征聚合相结合。 这种设计使得连续的编码器块能够在没有恒等捷径的情况下转换特征，同时让来自不同编码器深度的信息可供解码器访问。 通过所提出的初始化方法，DDT-RFE在四个视觉理解任务中，使用更少的编码器块就实现了相对于DDT的整体性能提升。 在相同的训练预算下，它在ImageNet上的图像生成也获得了更低的FID值。 我们的消融研究进一步表明，初始化和输出特征聚合都至关重要。 综合来看，这些结果表明，将编码器内部的特征转换与其输出端的特征聚合分离开来，有助于提升表示学习和图像生成效果。 我们希望我们的研究结果能鼓励学界重新思考信息在编码器各块之间的流动方式，以及这种流动如何影响扩散模型中抽象表示的学习。

paragraphs.en: We ablate the proposed initialization scheme and feature fusion in DDT-RFE-L/2, with quantitative results in Table 8 and feature visualizations in Fig. 4 . Removing the proposed initialization increases FID from 7.68 to 9.86 and substantially reduces performance on the visual understanding tasks. In Fig. 4 , we can see that most representations have collapsed due to network conditioning issues ( Ji et al., 2025 ) . Removing feature fusion only leads to much larger performance drops in both image generation and visual understanding. However, we empirically find that additionally removing the output gates helps recover performance. Nevertheless, this variant still underperforms the full recipe. Specifically, it increases FID by 0.66 and reduces classification accuracy, segmentation mIoU, and correspondence PCK by 0.2 percentage points, 1.1 points, and 4.4 percentage points, respectively. Qualitatively, the model learns some abstraction in the middle blocks, but it still attempts to retain detailed information because no alternative pathways are available.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 DDT-RFE-L/2 中分别去除了所提出的初始化方案与特征融合机制，定量结果见表 8，特征可视化结果见图 4。 移除所提出的初始化方案会使 FID 从 7.68 上升至 9.86，并显著降低视觉理解任务的性能。 从图 4 中可以看出，由于网络条件化问题，大多数表示已发生坍缩（Ji et al., 2025）。 仅移除特征融合机制会导致图像生成与视觉理解任务中的性能下降幅度更大。 然而，我们通过实证发现，进一步移除输出门有助于恢复模型性能。 尽管如此，该变体版本的表现仍低于完整方案。 具体而言，FID 增加了 0.66，分类准确率、分割 mIoU 和对应关系 PCK 分别下降了 0.2 个百分点、1.1 个点和 4.4 个百分点。 从定性角度看，模型在中层块中学习到了一些抽象特征，但由于没有替代路径可用，它仍试图保留细节信息。
